utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: I'm going to ask the Registrar to call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is case number IT-04-82-A, the Prosecutor versus Ljube Boskoski and Johan Tarculovski.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: And may have I the appearances, beginning with the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MS. MARTIN-SALGADO
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. My name is Elena Martin-Salgado, and I'm appearing today on behalf of the Prosecution with Francois Boudreault and Lourdes Galicia.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. And for the Defence of Mr. Boskoski.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Guenael Mettraux on behalf of Mr. Boskoski.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Mettraux. And for the Defence of Mr. Tarculovski. MR. N. DERSHOWITZ: [Via teleconference] Nathan Dershowitz by --

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. On behalf of Johan Tarculovski, Attorney Antonio Apostolski.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: [Overlapping speakers] Nathan Dershowitz -- MR. N. DERSHOWITZ: [Via teleconference] Correct, by telephone.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: -- is by teleconference. MR. N. DERSHOWITZ: [Via teleconference] Thank you, Your Honour. This is Nathan Dershowitz.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Now, as you know this is a Status Conference called in accordance Rule 65 bis which requires that a Status Conference be convened within 120 days of the last Status Conference, to allow any person in custody pending appeal the opportunity to raise issues in relation thereto, including the mental and physical condition of that person. The last time Mr. Tarculovski had the opportunity to raise issues regarding his detention was during the appeal hearing on the 29th of October, 2009. So may I ask, Mr. Tarculovski, whether you have any issues to raise concerning your custody, your mental and physical well-being. THE APPELLANT TARCULOVSKI: [Interpretation] Thank you very much for this question, Your Honour. I don't have anything to say. Everything is fine.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Tarculovski. I am to say that the Judgement in this appeal will be rendered in -- in due course, and the date on which it will be rendered will be announced shortly. May I ask any of the counsel whether they have any issues to raise?

utterances.speaker: MS. MARTIN-SALGADO
utterances.text: We don't have any issues to raise, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: No issue, Your Honour. Thank you. MR. N. DERSHOWITZ: [Via teleconference] No issues, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, the Defence has no questions. Maybe my colleague Dershowitz, who is on the phone line, maybe he has some issues to raise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Mr. Dershowitz, are you hearing us? MR. N. DERSHOWITZ: [Via teleconference] Yes, I do hear, and I do not have any -- any issues to raise --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: I didn't hear you well, but I gathered you were saying you did not have any issues to raise; is that correct? MR. N. DERSHOWITZ: [Via teleconference] That is correct, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Mr. Dershowitz? MR. N. DERSHOWITZ: [Via teleconference] Yes, that is correct, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Well, I can only say you have set for -- which I wish other proceedings would follow, in the brevity of these proceedings. I thank you for coming, and the Status Conference and the hearing are adjourned. MR. N. DERSHOWITZ: [Via teleconference] Thank you, Your Honour.
